name: Sullivan's Crossing
description: After Neurosurgeon Maggie Sullivan’s personal and professional life are thrown into turmoil she returns home to Sullivan’s Crossing. While there, Maggie is forced to navigate her complicated present while confronting the painful past she has chosen to ignore for years.

videos.title: Coming Home
videos.overview: When neurosurgeon Maggie Sullivan's seemingly perfect life in Boston is turned upside down, she leaves the city and her boyfriend, Andrew, to return to her childhood home of Sullivan's Crossing in Nova Scotia.

videos.title: Homewrecker
videos.overview: Maggie sees Cal in a new light after they help an injured resident and spend time together at karaoke.

videos.title: Detours
videos.overview: Sydney attempts to cheer up Maggie after she suffers a setback back at home. Frank and Edna help Sully, with the annual land blessing, but the festivities end early after a camper goes missing. Maggie and Cal work together with the search and rescue team unaware that another life hangs in the balance.

videos.title: Rock and a Hard Place
videos.overview: Maggie and Cal work against the clock in a daring medical rescue, and in the process discover a clue to the whereabouts of a missing camper. Maggie learns a little more about Cal’s past, while Sully receives disturbing news.

videos.title: Pressure Drop
videos.overview: Maggie makes a difficult decision after Sully lets his temper get the best of him.

videos.title: Boiling Point
videos.overview: Sully tries to hold things together at Sullivan's Crossing, while Maggie attempts to navigate complications back in Boston, Mass.

videos.title: Second Chances
videos.overview: Tensions escalate as Maggie returns to Sullivan's Crossing with Andrew.

videos.title: Aftershock
videos.overview: Maggie struggles to make sense of her personal life. Sully deals with some financial challenges.

videos.title: Can't Help Falling
videos.overview: Maggie's medical training is put to the test as she races against the clock to save the life of a friend.

videos.title: Sins of the Father
videos.overview: Maggie returns to Boston prepared to face the consequences of her actions, while Cal searches for closure of his own.

videos.title: Guilt Trip
videos.overview: Maggie Sullivan returns to the Crossing to find Sully in the hospital, struggling with the feeling that he's forgotten something; Cal Jones is confused when Maggie gives him the cold shoulder, unaware that Lola pocketed his goodbye letter.

videos.title: A Storm Is Brewing
videos.overview: Maggie searches for clues regarding the cause of Sully's condition as she struggles to make a decision about her own future.

videos.title: Confessions
videos.overview: Maggie, Cal, Lola, and Sydney help Edna prepare the campground for a storm as Frank helps Sully to figure out what's been eating at him.

videos.title: Eye of the Storm
videos.overview: Things start to heat up between Maggie and Cal when they're forced to take shelter at Cal's cabin.

videos.title: Secrets
videos.overview: Uncertain about her own future as well as that of the Crossing, Maggie tries to find a way to help Sully.

videos.title: Revelations
videos.overview: Maggie's world is turned upside down after she learns some devastating news about her stepfather.

videos.title: Reunions
videos.overview: Reeling over the news of Maggie's pregnancy, Cal receives a visitor; Phoebe and Sully start to bond over the idea of being grandparents.

videos.title: Truth and Consequences
videos.overview: Maggie helps care for Cal's sister and in the process learns more about his past.

videos.title: Remorse
videos.overview: Maggie enlists Cal’s help when Sully becomes convinced he needs to take drastic measures to make amends with Lola.

videos.title: It's a Wonderful Life
videos.overview: Cal works with Maggie as she fights to save the Crossing, while a careless mistake may cost someone their life.

videos.title: New Beginnings
videos.overview: Maggie tries to embrace her new life at the Crossing as she struggles to move past the loss she suffered the night of the diner fire.

videos.title: Out of the Blue
videos.overview: Maggie and Cal's relationship starts to heat up; Sully realizes he has some things in common with Helen.

videos.title: The Ties That Bind
videos.overview: Maggie accompanies Cal to visit his parents; Sully and Frank get to the bottom of who's behind the new development.

videos.title: A Clear Perspective
videos.overview: Maggie tries to help Cal deal with his conflicted feelings towards his father; Sully worries about how he will compete with the new development.

videos.title: Misunderstandings
videos.overview: Maggie grows concerned about Cal after he makes a series of rash decisions, while an unexpected visitor threatens Sully and Rob's plans for the diner.

videos.title: Bad Timing
videos.overview: Everyone at the Crossing pitches in to try and help Rob save his new restaurant while Maggie and Cal continue to drift apart.

videos.title: Twists and Turns
videos.overview: Everyone at the Crossing bands together to look for Lola and Jacob when it comes to light that the two never made it home from the woods.

videos.title: Blindsided
videos.overview: As Glenn's condition deteriorates, Maggie thinks there may be a connection to a firefighter who collapsed during renovations at the lodge.

videos.title: First Cut is the Deepest
videos.overview: Maggie faces a difficult decision after a loved one becomes ill.

videos.title: Head to the Heart
videos.overview: Cal believes that Maggie's missing her career, while relationships come to a head at the opening of Rob's restaurant.

videos.title: Curveballs
videos.overview: As Maggie digs into the reasons for her ex-husband Liam's return, Cal finds himself struggling with feelings of jealousy as tensions at the Crossing rise.

videos.title: Open Wounds
videos.overview: Maggie and Cal continue to deal with the fallout of Liam's arrival.

videos.title: Northern Lights
videos.overview: Maggie looks for a doctor to support her application to the board of physicians and Cal discovers information that causes him to question Maggie's history with Liam.

videos.title: Gut Instincts
videos.overview: Maggie's residency gets off to a rocky start as Cal shows Ben the ropes at the Crossing and begins to wonder if Liam has any intention of leaving.

videos.title: Abandoning
videos.overview: Maggie tries to figure out what's causing Tracy's fever as Cal learns that Ben hasn't been honest with them and Liam finally comes clean about what happened in the past.

videos.title: Falling Through the Cracks
videos.overview: After learning the truth, Maggie struggles to reconcile her unresolved feelings for Liam while helping Cal look for Ben and Tracy.

videos.title: Face the Music
videos.overview: Maggie struggles to find the right time to come clean about what happened with Liam while Cal gets an unexpected visitor.

videos.title: Let it Go
videos.overview: The rift between Cal and Maggie widens as Liam decides he's staying at the Crossing.

videos.title: We Can Work It Out
videos.overview: A casual outing takes a perilous turn after Maggie agrees to let Liam try and cheer her up.

videos.title: Healing Hearts
videos.overview: While everyone gathers to celebrate the land ceremony, Maggie makes a difficult decision as she faces the fact she may have lost Cal for good.
